instructions:
## Research objective

Improve retrieval when incoming image or text queries shift away from the training distribution, using online adaptation.

## Work to perform

Work with CLIP and BLIP baselines. The brief includes image corruptions, text perturbations, cross-domain shifts (Flickr, COCO, Fashion, Nocaps), and person-retrieval shifts between CUHK and ICFG. Retain the published retrieval directions and evaluation settings when comparing methods.

Start from the supplied baseline repository, formulate an improvement, implement it, execute the experiments, and use observed results to refine the method. The benchmark withholds the original paper’s proposed solution.

## Deliverable

An adaptation/retrieval implementation runnable with the supplied grading code.

## Evaluation

Recall@1 for the specified image-to-text/text-to-image shifts. Compare against the baseline values in the linked task brief. Evaluation datasets/conditions are component subtasks of this research environment, not separately provisioned workspaces.

## Resources

ResearchGym reports autonomous 12–24-hour runs and fixed API budgets. The README default API budget is $10; exact GPU model is not specified in this task brief.

This is a paraphrased reading guide. [Read the complete task instructions and baseline tables](https://github.com/Anikethh/ResearchGym/blob/main/tasks/test/cross-modal-retrieval/task_description.md).
